facts.fact: The Centre National de l'Informatique states that the national civil status system Madania manages all civil status documents on a centralised database and publishes them online, regardless of the place of registration, at municipalities and municipal arrondissements ('municipal counties'), with data transmitted between the user sites; the page is undated, so the document's published date (a proxy year) is used, and no count of municipalities is given.
facts.system: Madania (municipal sites working on the national civil status database)

facts.fact: Madania, the national civil status system used at municipal sites, is presented by the Centre National de l'Informatique, the state computing centre, among the projects it manages; the page is undated, so the document's published date (a proxy year) is used.
facts.system: Madania (municipal sites working on the national civil status database)
